name: meeting-agent
description: Reusable meeting engine: joins, transcribes, and reports on meetings.

scripts.typecheck: out=$(tsc --noEmit 2>&1); code=$?; printf '%s\n' "$out"; if [ $code -eq 0 ]; then exit 0; fi; printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -q 'error TS18003' && exit 0; exit $code
scripts.build: out=$(tsc 2>&1); code=$?; printf '%s\n' "$out"; if [ $code -eq 0 ]; then exit 0; fi; printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -q 'error TS18003' && exit 0; exit $code
